model.title: GPO Modernization Act of 2026
model.meta: Oversight and Government Reform Committee, House Administration · Rep. Stephanie Bice (R-OK)

summary.text: The bill would update how the Government Publishing Office operates and provides public access to federal documents, including modernizing its Federal Depository Library Program to focus on digital formats rather than requiring libraries to maintain minimum numbers of physical books. It would also rename and update the oversight committee for the agency, allow the office to accept gifts and provide publishing services, adjust employee benefits rules, and require the Library of Congress to publish the Constitution Annotated in digital form online instead of producing hardbound versions.
